data.label: Business Registry Governed Record
data.description: A business registry record. The governed record: the data cluster, the PROV activity and agent and the audit event from the ProvGov library by identifier, and the digital signature proof. Members: Business Registry Office; prov-activity (Provgov); prov-agent (Provgov); audit-event (Provgov); Digital Signature Proof.

items.label: Digital Signature Proof
items.description: Cryptographic proof of attestation (digital signature)

items.label: Audit Event
items.description: A logged access or custody event as data: what was done, by whom, on what, with what outcome and for what purpose. The audit-only case of sdc5 issue 002; state-changing operations are workflow transitions.

items.label: Audit Agent Reference
items.description: The acting agent (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.who). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Entity Reference
items.description: The entity the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.entity.what). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Event Identifier
items.description: The identifier of the audit event.

items.label: Data Subject Reference
items.description: The data subject or patient the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.patient; SDC DM.subject). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The party on whose behalf the agent acted (FHIR agent.onBehalfOf; prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: System Identifier
items.description: The system that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.source.observer; SDC AuditType.system-id).

items.label: System Location Name
items.description: The site or facility that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.location; prov:atLocation).

items.label: Audit Event Action
items.description: The operation performed in a logged access event (FHIR AuditEvent.action). Read and Execute change no state and are audit facts, not workflow moves.

items.label: Audit Event Outcome
items.description: The result of an audited event (FHIR AuditEvent.outcome).

items.label: Confidentiality
items.description: The level of protection the information requires (HL7 v3 Confidentiality). At assembly the value populates a component's act tag.

items.label: Provenance Agent Type
items.description: The functional role of an agent in an activity (FHIR Provenance.agent.type).

items.label: Purpose of Use
items.description: Why the information was used (HL7 v3 ActReason purpose of use). Activity context, not an access-control tag.

items.label: Audit Recorded At
items.description: When the audit event was recorded (FHIR AuditEvent.recorded).

items.label: Business Registry Office
items.description: A registered business: its Cordova business registry number and the NIEM organization (Default organization name by identifier, category, dates, identifications, location and contact information). Members: Business Registry Number; organization (NIEM).

items.label: Business Registry Number
items.description: Cordova Business Registration Number. Format: BIZ-NNNNNN where NNNNNN is a six-digit sequence number assigned at incorporation. Required for all business filings, tax records, and port authority transactions.

items.label: Organization (NIEM)
items.description: A data type for a body of people organized for a particular purpose. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationType. Members: organization-name (Default); Organization Abbreviation; Organization Doing Business As Name; Organization Branch Name; Organization Unit Name; Organization Sub Unit Name; Organization Category; Organization Category ND Ex Code; Organization Description; Organization Active Indicator; Organization Incorporated Indicator; Organization Established Date; Organization Incorporation Date; Organization Termination Date; Organization Identification; Organization Tax Identification; Organization LEI Identification; Organization ORI Identification; Organization Parent Organization Reference; Organization Principal Official Reference; Organization Jurisdiction Reference; Organization Status; Location (NIEM); Contact Information (NIEM).

items.label: Organization Active Indicator
items.description: True if an organization is active; false if it is inactive. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationActiveIndicator.

items.label: Organization Incorporated Indicator
items.description: True if an organization is incorporated; false otherwise. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationIncorporatedIndicator.

items.label: Organization Abbreviation
items.description: An abbreviation, acronym, or code for an organization name. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationAbbreviationText.

items.label: Organization Branch Name
items.description: A name of the chapter or branch by which an organization is known within a larger group of organizations. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationBranchName.

items.label: Organization Category
items.description: A kind or functional type of organization. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationCategoryText.

items.label: Organization Description
items.description: A description of an organization. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationDescriptionText.

items.label: Organization Doing Business As Name
items.description: A name an organization uses for conducting business. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationDoingBusinessAsName.

items.label: Organization Identification
items.description: An identification that references an organization. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationIdentification. The identifier value (nc:IdentificationID).

items.label: Organization Jurisdiction Reference
items.description: An area of service or jurisdiction an organization has over a region. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationJurisdiction. Holds the IRI of the referenced Jurisdiction record.

items.label: Organization LEI Identification
items.description: An identification for a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI), to uniquely identify legally distinct entities that engage in financial transactions. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationLEIIdentification. The identifier value (nc:IdentificationID).

items.label: Organization ORI Identification
items.description: A unique nine character NCIC identification (ORI) assigned to a justice-related organization by the FBI CJIS Division. NIEM 6.0 j:OrganizationORIIdentification. The identifier value (nc:IdentificationID).

items.label: Organization Parent Organization Reference
items.description: An organization that owns, controls, or operates the organization. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationParentOrganization. Holds the IRI of the referenced Organization record.

items.label: Organization Principal Official Reference
items.description: A chief or high ranking executive of an organization. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationPrincipalOfficial. Holds the IRI of the referenced Person record.

items.label: Organization Status
items.description: A status of an organization. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationStatus. The status as text (nc:StatusText).

items.label: Organization Sub Unit Name
items.description: A name of a subdivision of an organization. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationSubUnitName.

items.label: Organization Tax Identification
items.description: A tax identification assigned to an organization. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationTaxIdentification. The identifier value (nc:IdentificationID).

items.label: Organization Unit Name
items.description: A name of a high-level division of an organization. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationUnitName.

items.label: Organization Name
items.description: The legal or registered name of an organization.

items.label: Organization Category ND Ex Code
items.description: A kind of organization. NIEM 6.0 j:OrganizationCategoryNDExCode. Codes of ndex:OrganizationCategoryCodeSimpleType (23 values).

items.label: Organization Established Date
items.description: A date an organization was started. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationEstablishedDate.

items.label: Organization Incorporation Date
items.description: A date an organization incorporated (e.g., corporation). NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationIncorporationDate.

items.label: Organization Termination Date
items.description: A date an organization went out of business. NIEM 6.0 nc:OrganizationTerminationDate.

items.label: Contact Information (NIEM)
items.description: A data type for how to contact a person or an organization. NIEM 6.0 nc:ContactInformationType. Members: contact-point (Default); Contact Information Availability Code; Contact Information Description; Contact Entity Description; Address (NIEM).

items.label: Contact Entity Description
items.description: A description of the entity being contacted. NIEM 6.0 nc:ContactEntityDescriptionText.

items.label: Contact Information Description
items.description: A description of the contact information. NIEM 6.0 nc:ContactInformationDescriptionText.

items.label: Contact Information Availability Code
items.description: A period of time or a situation in which an entity is available to be contacted with the given contact information. NIEM 6.0 nc:ContactInformationAvailabilityCode. Codes of nc:ContactInformationAvailabilityCodeSimpleType (6 values).

items.label: Address (NIEM)
items.description: A data type for a geophysical location described by postal information. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressType. Members: international-address (Default); Address Category Code; Address Full; Address Secondary Unit; Address Private Mailbox; Address Recipient Name; Address Urbanization Name; Address Building Name; Address Delivery Point; Address County Name; County (fips); Address Postal Extension Code.

items.label: Address Building Name
items.description: A name of a specific building at an address to distinguish it from other buildings at the same site. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressBuildingName.

items.label: Address County Name
items.description: A name of a county, parish, vicinage, or other such geopolitical subdivision of a state. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressCountyName.

items.label: Address Delivery Point
items.description: A single place or unit at which mail is delivered. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressDeliveryPointText.

items.label: Address Full
items.description: A complete address. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressFullText.

items.label: Address Postal Extension Code
items.description: An identifier of a smaller area within a post office-assigned zone for an address. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressPostalExtensionCode.

items.label: Address Private Mailbox
items.description: A private mailbox within a company. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressPrivateMailboxText.

items.label: Address Recipient Name
items.description: A name of a person, organization, or other recipient to whom physical mail may be sent. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressRecipientName.

items.label: Address Secondary Unit
items.description: A particular unit within a larger unit or grouping at a location. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressSecondaryUnitText.

items.label: Address Urbanization Name
items.description: An urbanization denotes an area, sector, or residential development within a geographic area. Commonly used in Puerto Rican urban areas, it is an important part of the addressing format, as it describes the location of a specific street whose name may occur multiple times within the same ZIP Code. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressUrbanizationName.

items.label: Address Category Code
items.description: A kind of address. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressCategoryCode. Codes of nc:AddressCategoryCodeSimpleType (5 values).

items.label: County (fips)
items.description: A unique county, parish, vicinage, or other such geopolitical subdivision of a state. A coded value: the US County5 Digit code, its display text and the fixed code list fips:USCounty5DigitCodeSimpleType (3222 codes), resolved on the list IRI. NIEM 6.0 fips:CountyCode.

items.label: Code List: fips US County5 Digit
items.description: The code list of a coded value, fixed: fips:USCounty5DigitCodeSimpleType (3222 codes). A data type for unique 5-digit US county codes, with a 2-digit state code followed by a 3-digit county code. NIEM 6.0 fips:USCounty5DigitCodeSimpleType.

items.label: Code Display Text
items.description: The human-readable display of a coded value, as recorded with the code: the preferred label of the code (SKOS prefLabel). In NIEM the equivalent is the *Text substitution beside a *Code.

items.label: County Code (fips)
items.description: The US County5 Digit code: A unique county, parish, vicinage, or other such geopolitical subdivision of a state. NIEM 6.0 fips:CountyCode, coded in fips:USCounty5DigitCodeSimpleType.

items.label: International Address
items.description: A mailing address in any country: street lines, city, region, postal code, country and use.

items.label: Address (Line 1)
items.description: The first line of a street address: street number and name, or a post office box.

items.label: Address (Line 2)
items.description: The second line of a street address: apartment, suite, unit, building or floor, when the first line does not carry it.

items.label: City Name
items.description: The name of the city, town or village in an address.

items.label: Postal Code
items.description: The postal code of an address in any country, with no format constraint. Use US ZIP Code or Canada Postal Code where the format is known.

items.label: Region Name
items.description: The name of the state, province or other administrative region in an address, written out rather than coded.

items.label: Address Use
items.description: The purpose of an address.

items.label: Country Code ISO 3166
items.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of a country or territory: the complete list of 249 officially assigned codes. Each value is defined by its Wikidata entity.

items.label: Contact Point
items.description: Ways to reach a person or organization: phone, fax, email, website, and the method and use of the contact.

items.label: Website URL
items.description: The URL of a web page or online resource, such as an organization's website or a person's profile page.

items.label: Email Address
items.description: An email address. The pattern requires a local part, an at sign and a domain with a dot; RFC 5321 limits the whole address to 254 characters.

items.label: Fax Number
items.description: A facsimile telephone number, optionally starting with a plus sign and country code, with digits, spaces, hyphens and parentheses allowed.

items.label: Phone Number
items.description: A telephone number, optionally starting with a plus sign and country code, with digits, spaces, hyphens and parentheses allowed.

items.label: Contact Method
items.description: The communication channel of a contact point.

items.label: Contact Use
items.description: The purpose of a contact point.

items.label: Location (NIEM)
items.description: A data type for geospatial location. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocationType. Members: geolocation (Default); Address (NIEM); Location Name; Location Description; Location Category; Location Directions; Location Identification; Location Altitude; Location Elevation; Location Landmark Name; Location Range Description; Location Surrounding Area Description; Locale.

items.label: Location Category
items.description: A kind or functional description of a location. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocationCategoryText.

items.label: Location Description
items.description: A description of a location. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocationDescriptionText.

items.label: Location Directions
items.description: A set of directions to a location. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocationDirectionsText.

items.label: Location Identification
items.description: An identification of a Location. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocationIdentification. The identifier value (nc:IdentificationID).

items.label: Location Landmark Name
items.description: A name of a landmark. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocationLandmarkName.

items.label: Location Name
items.description: A name of a location. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocationName.

items.label: Location Range Description
items.description: A description of the boundary or range of a location. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocationRangeDescriptionText.

items.label: Location Surrounding Area Description
items.description: A description of the immediate area around a location. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocationSurroundingAreaDescriptionText.

items.label: Location Altitude
items.description: A measurement of the height or position of a location above a certain reference. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocationAltitude. A quantity in the Length Units (SI and customary).

items.label: Location Elevation
items.description: A measure of the distance of a point on the Earth from a reference point. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocationElevation. A quantity in the Length Units (SI and customary).

items.label: Geolocation
items.description: A point on the Earth: latitude, longitude, altitude and the geodetic datum they are expressed in.

items.label: Geodetic Datum
items.description: The coordinate reference system of a latitude and longitude pair, by EPSG code. WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) is what GPS and most web maps use.

items.label: Altitude
items.description: Height above the reference ellipsoid or sea level, in SI length units.

items.label: Latitude
items.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees, -90 to +90.

items.label: Longitude
items.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees, -180 to +180.

items.label: Locale
items.description: A data type for a geopolitical area. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocaleType. Members: Locale Region Name; Locale District Name; Locale Neighborhood Name; Locale Community Name; Locale Subdivision Name; Locale Zone Name; Locale Census Tract ID; Locale Census Block ID; Locale Police Beat; Locale Police Grid; Locale Police Jurisdiction ID; Locale Fire Jurisdiction ID; Locale Emergency Services Jurisdiction ID; Locale Emergency Services Name; Locale Judicial District Name; Locale Description.

items.label: Locale Census Block ID
items.description: An identifier of the smallest subdivision of an area. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocaleCensusBlockID.

items.label: Locale Census Tract ID
items.description: An identifier of a designated census tract area. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocaleCensusTractID.

items.label: Locale Community Name
items.description: A name of a specific community. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocaleCommunityName.

items.label: Locale Description
items.description: A description of a geopolitical area. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocaleDescriptionText.

items.label: Locale District Name
items.description: A name given to an area defined for administrative or official purposes. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocaleDistrictName.

items.label: Locale Emergency Services Jurisdiction ID
items.description: An identifier of an emergency services jurisdiction that encompasses a location. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocaleEmergencyServicesJurisdictionID.

items.label: Locale Emergency Services Name
items.description: A name of an organization providing emergency services. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocaleEmergencyServicesName.

items.label: Locale Fire Jurisdiction ID
items.description: An identifier of a fire department jurisdiction. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocaleFireJurisdictionID.

items.label: Locale Judicial District Name
items.description: A name of the judicial district. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocaleJudicialDistrictName.

items.label: Locale Neighborhood Name
items.description: A name of a neighborhood. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocaleNeighborhoodName.

items.label: Locale Police Beat
items.description: A police beat that encompasses a location. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocalePoliceBeatText.

items.label: Locale Police Grid
items.description: A police grid coordinate. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocalePoliceGridText.

items.label: Locale Police Jurisdiction ID
items.description: An identifier of a police jurisdiction that encompasses a location. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocalePoliceJurisdictionID.

items.label: Locale Region Name
items.description: A name of a region. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocaleRegionName.

items.label: Locale Subdivision Name
items.description: A name of a subdivision. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocaleSubdivisionName.

items.label: Locale Zone Name
items.description: A name of a zone. NIEM 6.0 nc:LocaleZoneName.

items.label: PROV Activity
items.description: A PROV activity: what it was, when it ran, its status, and the entities, activities, agent and plan it relates to.

items.label: Activity Description
items.description: A description of what the activity does and why.

items.label: Activity Identifier
items.description: The identifier of a PROV activity: a URI or another globally unique identifier.

items.label: Activity Label
items.description: A human-readable label for a PROV activity.

items.label: Activity Location
items.description: Where the activity took place (prov:atLocation), as text.

items.label: Activity Type
items.description: The kind of activity, in the vocabulary of the domain (prov:type).

items.label: Error Message
items.description: The error the activity reported, if it failed.

items.label: Had Plan Reference
items.description: The plan the activity followed (prov:hadPlan). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Used Entity Reference
items.description: An entity the activity used (prov:used). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Associated With Reference
items.description: The agent associated with the activity (prov:wasAssociatedWith). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Ended By Reference
items.description: The entity that ended the activity (prov:wasEndedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Informed By Reference
items.description: An activity that informed this one (prov:wasInformedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Started By Reference
items.description: The entity that started the activity (prov:wasStartedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Activity Status
items.description: The state of an activity, from the Data Privacy Vocabulary activity status concepts.

items.label: Ended At
items.description: When the activity ended (prov:endedAtTime).

items.label: Started At
items.description: When the activity started (prov:startedAtTime).

items.label: PROV Agent
items.description: A PROV agent: a person, organization or software agent, with its identity, contact and delegation.

items.label: Acted On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The agent on whose behalf this agent acted (prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Agent Description
items.description: A description of the agent and its responsibilities.

items.label: Agent Email
items.description: The agent's email address (foaf:mbox).

items.label: Agent Identifier
items.description: The identifier of a PROV agent: a URI or another globally unique identifier.

items.label: Agent Name
items.description: The name of the agent (foaf:name).

items.label: Agent Organization Name
items.description: The organization the agent belongs to or is.

items.label: Software Name
items.description: The name of a software agent.

items.label: Software Version
items.description: The version of a software agent.

items.label: PROV Agent Type
items.description: The kind of PROV agent: person, organization or software agent.
